sentences.text: Upon registration of the First Information Report, the petitioner prayed for anticipatory bail.
We are informed that the anticipatory bail was granted but was limited only up to the filing of the charge-sheet.

Upon filing of the charge sheet, instead of furnishing bail bond before the Special Court, the petitioner thought fit to prefer an application before the High Court seeking quashing of the charge-sheet.
Such prayer was declined.
2. Thereafter a fresh application for anticipatory bail was filed which has been rejected.
3. In view of what has been observed above, we direct the petitioner to appear before the Trial Court where the criminal case is pending and furnish bail bond to the satisfaction of the Trial Court.
The petitioner, as on date, is 74 years of age.
4. We are granting this indulgence with a distinct understanding that the petitioner shall thereafter appear before the Trial Court on each date fixed for the progress of the trial.
5. Issue notice.
6. In the meantime, there shall be no arrest.
Subsequently, this Court has been informed by the learned counsel for the petitioner that the petitioners bail bond has been accepted by the Court concerned and he is presently on bail.
None appears for the State of Uttar Pradesh.
Learned counsel for the petitioner is permitted to serve the copy of the petition to the Standing Counsel for the State of Uttar Pradesh.

(NIRMALA NEGI) (RENU BALA GAMBHIR)
COURT MASTER (SH) COURT MASTER (NSH)
